items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: There was a strollin' guitar [gi-tar] player, a guy who played guitar who was known in the town -- Black Hamp and...Black Nolan(?). Helluva guitar player.

ctx.x: Yeah. His brother was... There was brother who had a camp on the lake, dealt from it all his life. Dealt in fish and crabs for the restaurants in town. So while I had Creole food with my French people, my mother's people, and I had Country food with my grandmother and my father's people. They came out of New Iberia. I'll tell you how they got here later on.

But getting back to this music, there was music all around. Everywhere that guys could whistle. There was a strollin' guitar [gi-tar] player, a guy who played guitar who was known in the town -- Black Hamp and...Black Nolan(?). Helluva guitar player. That Folk guitar, that Leadbelly (?) that you play with your fingers.
